intro.text: A lighteyed soldier of the Kholinar Wall Guard in Noro's squad, alongside Kaladin.

items.text: Vaceslv got to know Kaladin as a fellow soldier in Noro's squad. He and Alaward kept asking Kaladin to play cards, but Kaladin always declined, thinking of Sah and the other parshmen.
Vaceslv took a gash to the chest in a Fused raid that needed a surgeon, but he recovered.
Vaceslv followed Kaladin into the palace with his squad and fought in the battle there. Most of the squad, including Noro and Beard, were killed; Vaceslv isn't mentioned among the few survivors.

personality.text: A friendly man of the tenth dahn who thinks middle-ranking lighteyes useless, and mocks their love of fancy clothes.
Trained with side sword, truncheon and small shield for patrols, and with tower shield and pike in formation.
